description: N-CoreIQ SAP ECC Repository Intelligence Platform — Authorization Configuration

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.NCoreIQ.Viewer
scopes.description: Read-only access: SAP connectivity status, package browsing, repository search, metadata, source, dependencies

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.NCoreIQ.Analyst
scopes.description: Analyst access: all Viewer capabilities plus dependency traversal, reverse analysis, impact analysis, source export

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.NCoreIQ.Operator
scopes.description: Operator access: all Analyst capabilities plus job management, artifact operations, job cancellation and retry

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.NCoreIQ.Admin
scopes.description: Admin access: all Operator capabilities plus diagnostics, configuration visibility, administrative operations

role-collections.name: NCoreIQ Viewer
role-collections.description: Assigns N-CoreIQ read-only access to a user

role-collections.name: NCoreIQ Analyst
role-collections.description: Assigns N-CoreIQ analyst access to a user

role-collections.name: NCoreIQ Operator
role-collections.description: Assigns N-CoreIQ operator access to a user

role-collections.name: NCoreIQ Administrator
role-collections.description: Assigns full N-CoreIQ administrator access to a user
